cue.purpose: First cue only, as a plain sentence, leading the live panel. If it would push a metric row off: hide notes, then step down to a 20sp floor, then drop the leading diagnosis sentence, then clamp to 3 lines.

value.purpose: Measured result on each metric row; tabular figures.

label.purpose: Row labels, setup title, check rows, status-chip line.

reference.purpose: Reference band at the right end of each row head; tabular figures.

badge.purpose: Worded status badges, segments, serve chips.

extensions.units: Android sp/dp map 1:1 to the px values in the frontmatter.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Panel, rows, chips, and menu are flat; separation is a 1dp hairline or a tonal step.

shadows.name: framing-keyline
shadows.purpose: Keeps the framing outline legible on any video background.

motion.name: result-dim
motion.purpose: The last result stays visible, dimmed, while the next serve is analyzed. No other custom motion; Material components keep platform transitions.

breakpoints.name: landscape-phone
breakpoints.value: camera 4:3 at full height; panel takes remaining width

narrative.overview:
The app is one quiet, neutral instrument standing next to a live camera. It is built from Meta's Astryx Neutral 0.4.1 tokens applied through stock Material 3 components on Android Views, so every control behaves like the platform and every surface reads as the same grey-and-white paper. Nothing on the panel is decorative: the camera supplies all the imagery, and the panel supplies words, numbers, and the reference each number is judged against.

Density is set for a glance from two to three metres in landscape. The coaching cue leads at the largest size; three measured rows follow, each with its label, a help button, and its reference on one line, then the value and a worded badge on the next. Color is reserved for status (green, amber, red) and selection (blue); everything else is the neutral ramp from near-black to near-white, in both light and dark themes.

The system is honest by construction. Status is always a word with a tint, never a tint alone; a result below the model's confidence gate is shown and labeled uncertain rather than hidden or rounded up; and every measured value sits beside the band it is compared with.
keyCharacteristics: Astryx Neutral tokens through native Material 3 roles, light and dark.
One surface panel beside a true 4:3 camera; the camera never moves.
Figtree throughout; three sizes carry the live screen (cue 24, value 22, label 15).
Flat: 1dp hairline borders and tonal steps, no resting shadows.
Lucide icons at 2dp stroke, tinted by token.
Worded status badges in three tones; uncertainty always labeled.

rules.name: The Status-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red appear only to report a measured status, and blue only to mark selection. A neutral control never takes a status hue for emphasis.

rules.name: The Words With Color Rule
rules.body: Every status tint carries a word: a badge label, a check-row sentence, or a status-chip line. A screen read in greyscale loses no result.

rules.name: The Fixed Camera Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn on the camera image uses the on-camera tokens, which are identical in light and dark themes, because the video does not change with the theme.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: The live screen is carried by three sizes: cue 24, value 22, label 15. A new live element takes one of them before it takes a new size.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change between serves (values, references, probabilities, timecodes) sets tnum, so columns and rows do not jitter.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Buttons and labels are sentence case with zero letter-spacing; nothing in the system is uppercase.

rules.name: The Rows Before Words Rule
rules.body: On the live screen the metric rows always stay visible. A long cue gives up its notes, then size (down to 20sp, never lower), then its opening diagnosis, then lines (3 maximum), never a row.

rules.name: The Reference On Every Row Rule
rules.body: A measured value never appears without the reference it is judged against on the same row. Live rows read "needs ≥ 60%", "0.03 (≥ 0.154)" and "band 13.4–165.7°"; the research table has a Reference column. Thresholds read the same everywhere (≥ 0.60, ≥ 0.154, 13.4–165.7°). A new metric ships with its reference or does not ship.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: The panel and everything on it are flat. Separation is a hairline or a tonal step, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Dim Not Hide Rule
rules.body: While the next serve is analyzed, the last result stays on screen at 45% opacity rather than disappearing.

dos: Do put the reference on every row that shows a measured value, in Reference type at the row's right end.
Do pair every status color with a word: badge text, a check sentence, or a status-chip line.
Do show uncertain results and label them: "Not sure" in Amber Ochre with "Low confidence", or "General cue · serve type uncertain" under the cue.
Do map new colors to Astryx tokens through Material roles in colors.xml and values-night, so light and dark stay paired.
Do use on-camera tokens for anything drawn over video, unchanged across themes, and give thin strokes on video a keyline.
Do show only the first cue live, and keep the full list behind "Show all cues (N)" in review.
Do keep touch targets at 48dp and numbers in tabular figures.
Do draw new icons from Lucide at 2dp stroke and tint them by token.
donts: Don't convey a result by color alone, or use green, amber, or red as decoration.
Don't hide or round up a result below the 0.60 confidence gate.
Don't add resting shadows to the panel, rows, chips, or menu; separate with a hairline or a tonal step.
Don't split the live panel into equal cards or add decorative sports chrome; one surface carries the cue and the rows.
Don't add a second typeface, uppercase labels, or letter-spaced labels.
Don't hard-code hex values in layouts or views where a token exists.
